<!-- generated by scripts/scrape.py -->

**Sidestep Duration (Su):** At 5th level, the time warden can spend one mote to hold off the end of a chosen spell's duration for himself only by an amount of time equal to the spell's normal duration.

This replaces the duration mote use.

**Sidestep Age (Sp):** At 13th level, the tempus ascendant is immune to effects that would age him or alter the rate at which time passes for him (such as slow or temporal stasis) unless he chooses to be affected. He ceases to age and does not die of old age.

This replaces the aevum gained at 13th level.
